MP Anganwadi Merit List 2026

Post Date: July 23, 2026

5:44 pm

Women and Child Development Department (WCD) has released the Merit List for the recruitment of MP Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts on its official website. This recruitment is being conducted for 2,548 vacancies. The application process started on 01 July 2026, and candidates can fill out the application form until 13 July 2026. Interested and eligible candidates who wish to apply for this recruitment can find all the relevant information and the application link in the Important Links section below.
